Roti Challenge

Legacy initiative

The Roti Challenge

When a community turned its kitchens into a movement.

During the 2020 lockdown, Bharosa Group created a simple way for families to help people who were struggling for food. That idea became the Roti Challenge.

ON THIS PAGE

How it workedIt was never just about rotiThe challenge that shaped AashrayMemories from 2020Our Work

How it worked

  1. Families accepted the challenge. Participating households chose to contribute rotis once a week.
  2. Rotis were prepared at home. Each family’s contribution became part of a shared community effort.
  3. The team collected from homes. Volunteers visited the households that had accepted the challenge.
  4. Food was packed together. The collected rotis and other food were brought to the team’s work location for packing.
  5. Volunteers went out to distribute. The team took the packed meals to people who needed food support.

02 / Roti Challenge

It was never just about roti

The Roti Challenge gave people a simple way to take part. Families contributed from their homes, while volunteers carried out the collection, packing and distribution.

Each part of the effort depended on the others. Together, those contributions helped turn concern for the community into meals and practical support.

03 / Roti Challenge

The challenge that shaped Aashray

The Roti Challenge remains an important part of our story. Its spirit continues to influence Aashray’s direction: creating ways for ordinary people to become part of community care.

04 / Roti Challenge

Memories from 2020

Our archive will bring together photographs and video memories from the initiative, preserving the work and participation behind the Roti Challenge.
